crossRefs.note: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be…
For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not…
God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even…

translations.web: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
translations.bsb: I have spoken once, but I have no answer— twice, but I have nothing to add.”
translations.kjv: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
translations.asv: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.
